title: LocalizationPrimitives
description: Shared schema module for reusable localization primitives referenced by multiple root contracts.

LocalizedTextKey.description: LocalizedText key. Supports base languages (e.g. 'de'), optional region variants (e.g. 'de-CH'), and optional politeness suffixes (e.g. 'de@formal', 'de-CH@informal').

LocalizedText.description: Map from localized text keys to concrete strings. Coverage across supportedLanguages is enforced by the containing contract and its preflight rules.
